title: The Durand and Humphrey band and its personnel
summary: Durand led a band with Willie Humphrey, whose grandfather Jim taught Durand. He names the members.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And, uh, also a lot of places that I played. We, my band was, uh, Durant and Humphrey, you remember Fess?
Young Willie Humphrey. Yeah, the clarinet. See, his father taught me how to play, you know.
No, his grandfather. His grandfather taught him.
Because his father was Willie too.
Mm-hmm. And mention them in the, in the orchestra, you had your orchestra. The, uh, Durant and Humphrey.
Who else is in that band?

Well, in Durant and Humphrey band? Mm-hmm. We had, uh, Bebe Mathis on drum. Willie, uh, Buddy Johnson, trombone, I'm playing trumpet. Willie Humphrey, clarinet. And a fellow by the name of Green playing banjo. And, uh, Jimmy Johnson was playing bass. Mm-hmm. Oh, we had a wonderful band. Pretty good band.
